entries.rationale: SV40 enhancer/promoter modules are intentional regulatory architecture in mammalian expression vectors; internal exact repeats overlapping the annotated regulatory module should be reviewed for synthesis/stability but should not by themselves prove the deposited source vector is invalid.
citations: GenBank U47121.2, Cloning vector pSI, mammalian expression vector, complete sequence: annotated SV40 enhancer and early promoter.
Banerji J, Rusconi S, Schaffner W. Expression of a beta-globin gene is enhanced by remote SV40 DNA sequences. Cell. 1981;27(2 Pt 1):299-308.

entries.rationale: The Saccharomyces cerevisiae 2-micron plasmid STB/ARS region is an intentional yeast-maintenance module in yeast shuttle vectors; exact repeats internal to the annotated maintenance feature should be reviewed but are not automatically source-vector defects.
citations: GenBank AF041805.1, AF041806.1, and AF041807.1 yGALset records: annotated S. cerevisiae 2 micron plasmid STB and ARS region.
Broach JR. The yeast plasmid 2 micron circle. Cell. 1981;28(2):203-204.
